purpose: Freeze the capability boundary used by the planning benchmark; this is not a runtime dependency certification.
included: Dedicated Data-Juicer operators present in the current operator catalog and referenced by exact name in a case oracle
Normal composition of those operators using their published schemas
excluded_escape_hatches: installing additional dependencies during a case
using a general LLM or VLM as an undocumented substitute for a missing deterministic capability
reachability_rule: A case is reachable only when the dedicated current operators can satisfy every hard acceptance criterion. Partial coverage does not make a case reachable.
runtime_rule: If a required catalog operator is unavailable in the actual runtime because of missing dependencies, model configuration, or credentials, report runtime_blocked separately. Do not change the catalog-level gold label.
allowed_extension_behavior: For an unreachable case, the planner may propose an external capability after declaring a capability gap. The proposal must not be represented as a current native solution.
